table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=item.packingdesc,  
		
	
		
		itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode), 
		genericname=(select name from genericitem where item.genericcode=genericitem.genericcode),
		manf=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
         address = dbo.customer.address1,   
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
         city= dbo.customer.city,
         licenceno= dbo.customer.licenceno,   
         username= dbo.users.username,   
         quotationcode = dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,   
         headerno = dbo.quotationheader.headerno,   
         date = dbo.quotationheader.date , 
         invdiscperc = dbo.quotationheader.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.quotationheader.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.quotationheader.salestax,   
         gcode = quotationdetail.gcode,   
         icode = quotationdetail.icode,   
       
         looseqty = quotationdetail.qty,   
         bonusqty = quotationdetail.bonusqty,   
  
         packunits= quotationdetail.packunits,   
         saleprice= quotationdetail.saleprice,   
         discperc = quotationdetail.discperc,   
         salestax = quotationdetail.salestax,  
			itemflatdisc=quotationdetail.itemflatdisc,   
         Id = dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=quotationheader.posted,   
 


         unitsalestax = quotationdetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = quotationdetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = quotationheader.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.quotationheader.custrefno,	
			dbo.quotationheader.remarks,
		salesman=(SELECT salesman.name FROM Salesman WHERE salesman.salesmancode=dbo.quotationheader.smancode),
		Message=(SELECT Message.description FROM Message WHERE Message.Messagecode=dbo.quotationheader.messagecode),
		CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME

    FROM quotationheader,   
         quotationdetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :ar_SInvCode  ) AND  
        
			( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode) AND 
			( dbo.quotationheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.quotationheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.quotationdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

ORDER BY dbo.quotationdetail.quotationcode,
			dbo.quotationdetail.IDENTITYCOL
